title: 前沿大语言模型在肿瘤学决策中的集体能力边界
summary: 该研究构建了肿瘤决策边界基准（ODBB），包含2005个肿瘤决策点，评估了9个前沿LLM。结果显示42.1%的决策点没有模型能正确回答，且模型在临床元判断上存在盲区，需要架构干预而非更多数据。
summary_en: This study introduces the Oncology Decision Boundary Benchmark (ODBB) with 2,005 decision points, evaluating nine frontier LLMs. Results show 42.1% of items were answered correctly by none, revealing blind spots in clinical meta-judgment requiring architectural intervention.
